title: A-linear evaluation-normalized global derived Hom model
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a bounded complex of flat A-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and I a K-injective complex [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Let C_E be the A-linear global Hom cochain complex [def-pur-hom-complex]. There is an isomorphism m:Q_A(C_E)≅RΓ(X,RHom(Q_X E,Q_X I)) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. For every A-complex U, chain map α:U→C_E and chain map t:constant(U)⊗E→I satisfying t(w⊗e)=α(w)(e), Q_A(α) followed by m is the derived transpose of Q_X(t) after the canonical constant and tensor comparisons. The isomorphism is in D(A), and this universal equation fixes its normalization.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 0A96, 08J9 and 08JA; normalized derived adjunction in Derived Categories Tag 09T5.

proof.text: Bounded flat E is K-flat. Its internal Hom H into I is K-injective by the tensor-Hom homotopy test, so ordinary sections of H compute the right-derived sections of derived internal Hom.

Sections commute with products and sections of sheaf Hom are module-sheaf morphisms. These identifications are A-linear. They send the product differential to d_I f−(−1)ⁿf d_E and give C_E as an A-complex model, rather than just an additive-complex model. In a native product-total internal Hom comparison, multiply the (p,n) component by (-1)^(p*n). Its differential is (-1)^p times the difference of post- and precomposition. The identities p*(n+1)=p*n+p and (p+1)*n=p*n+n verify conversion to the global cochain differential. Applying the same sign twice is identity.

The evaluation formula on every product projection identifies the ordinary transpose of t with α. Normalized constant/sections derived adjunction and the one-sided K-flat chain transpose give the required equation after localization. This applies to every U,α,t and determines m by taking U=C_E and α=identity.
